questions.answer: ⓒ — what is the secret → what the secret is
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 부분에서 어법상 어색한 것을 찾아 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고치시오.

ⓐ What matters most in friendship is trust.
ⓑ She showed us what she had made for the festival.
ⓒ I'm going to tell you what is the secret to success.
ⓓ He finally got what he had been working toward for years.
acceptedAnswers: ⓒ / what is the secret → what the secret is
ⓒ, what is the secret → what the secret is
ⓒ what is the secret to success → what the secret to success is
c — what is the secret → what the secret is
c, what is the secret → what the secret is
ⓒ — what's the secret → what the secret is
